approved.en: US is urging a European delegation to join Ukraine-Russia talks, which Moscow says it will not dictate. Russia sent a major business delegation to Kabul for talks with the Taliban and Azerbaijan increased its engagement at the EPC Summit. Ukraine launched strikes that hit a Russian military airfield in Astrakhan Oblast and a mass attack on Odesa Oblast killed four and injured many, while Russian drones hit Rostov Oblast, caused a fire in Tatarstan and damaged three commercial ships near Romania’s Black Sea coast. 75,767 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

Russland sendte en stor forretningsdelegasjon til Kabul for samtaler med Taliban, og Aserbajdsjan økte sin deltakelse på EPC-toppen. Ukraina gjennomførte angrep som traff en russisk militær flyplass i Astrakhan oblast, og et massivt angrep i Odesa oblast drepte fire og såret mange, mens russiske droner traff Rostov oblast, forårsaket brann i Tatarstan og skadet tre handelsskip nær Rumænias svartehavskyst. 75 767 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Israeli airstrikes on Gaza have hit Nasser Hospital, killing six people including a doctor, a child and a senior Hamas commander. Heavy rains have flooded tens of thousands of tents in Gaza, and a baby has died from cold. In the West Bank, Israeli settlers attacked Palestinians, wounding several, and Israeli troops occupied the home of a Palestinian-American. Kosovo fans booed and whistled the Israeli national anthem before a Nations League draw. The European Union called for immediate, unimpeded humanitarian aid to Gaza amid the flooding, and the United Nations reported 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Kraftig regn har oversvømt titusenvis av telt i Gaza, og et spedbarn har dødd av kulde. På Vestbredden angrep israelske bosettere palestinere, og såret flere, og israelske soldater okkuperte hjemmet til en palestinsk-amerikansk. Kosovo-supportere buet og plystret den israelske nasjonalsangen før en Nations-League-kamp endte uavgjort. Den europeiske unionen oppfordret til umiddelbar, uhindret humanitær hjelp til Gaza på grunn av flommen, og De forente nasjoner rapporterte 21 440 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Israel has stepped up strikes in southern Lebanon, hitting Qantara, causing an explosion in Khiam and flying drones over Beirut, while an overflight wounded a Lebanese footballer. The Lebanese army seized a large weapons cache in a Beirut suburb warehouse and another depot in the city’s southern suburbs. Hezbollah arrested five members in Batroun, continued artillery fire on Israeli positions and began cash payments to war victims and displaced families. UNRWA funding cuts have deepened hardship for Palestinian refugees in Lebanon. The conflict has caused 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Iran has launched a second drone attack on Bahrain within three days, targeting a U.S. military radar and striking a building in Tel Aviv with a missile, while Bahrain intercepted additional Iranian aerial attacks. The United States responded by striking Iran's Qeshm Island and disabling a commercial vessel in the Gulf of Oman. Iran also opened a women’s war-readiness training camp and designated the Argentine navy and air force as terrorist organisations, warning of retaliation against European bases hosting U.S. forces. Qatar reported progress in U.S., Iran talks after a White House meeting. 123 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

USA svarte med å slå mot Irans Qeshm-øy og deaktivere et handelsskip i Omanbukta. Iran åpnet også en kvinne-krigberedskapsleir og erklærte den argentinske marinen og luftforsvaret som terrororganisasjoner, og varslet gjengjeldelse mot europeiske baser som huser amerikanske styrker. Qatar rapporterte fremgang i USA-Iran-samtaler etter et møte i Det hvite hus. 123 kamprelaterte dødsfall ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Yemeni government forces have withdrawn from positions around Dhubab Airport and the Bab al-Mandeb area, allowing Houthi fighters to seize control of the strategic strait. In the same period Houthi forces intercepted Saudi-led coalition missile and drone attacks and killed a senior Yemeni military commander in clashes in Al-Jawf. The Houthis also stepped up missile strikes on Saudi Arabia, targeting Riyadh and other sites, while Saudi air defenses intercepted several missiles and a drone over eastern Saudi territory. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Jemeniske regjeringsstyrker har trukket seg tilbake fra posisjoner rundt Dhubab flyplass og Bab al-Mandeb-området, noe som gjør at houthiene har tatt kontroll over den strategiske sundet. I samme periode avbrøt houthiene missil- og droneangrep fra den saudisk-ledede koalisjonen og drepte en høytstående jemenisk militærkommandør i kamper i Al-Jawf. Houthiene intensiverte også missilangrep mot Saudi-Arabia, med mål på Riyadh og andre steder, mens saudiske luftforsvar avskjærte flere missiler og en drone over østlige Saudi-områder. Konflikten forårsaket 918 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

The UCDP recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: The Sudanese army has seized three locations in West Kordofan and is advancing toward Al-Nahud, expanding its territorial gains. The Rapid Support Forces continue to employ drones, striking civilian areas in West Kordofan and the Blue Nile, and a Sudanese drone was shot down after crossing from Ethiopia. RSF forces killed ten civilians in An-Nuhud. Humanitarian aid is deteriorating, with food assistance cut for 900,000 people. The conflict caused 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

RSF-styrker drepte ti sivile i An-Nuhud. Humanitær hjelp forverres, med matassistanse kuttet for 900 000 personer. Konflikten forårsaket 4 680 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: UN peacekeepers and South Sudan authorities ignored warnings before the Abiemnom massacre that killed at least 213 civilians, prompting Amnesty International to demand investigations. The government postponed the first post-independence elections again, now scheduled for February 2027, while opposition forces continue clashes with government troops in Akobo. Governors in Jonglei and Aweil East called for peace ahead of the delayed vote, and an ambush on a convoy killed two people, including a journalist. A CityLink Aviation plane crashed near Juba, killing all 14 aboard. There were 2 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: FN-styrker og myndighetene i Sør-Sudan ignorerte advarsler før Abiemnom-massakren som drepte minst 213 sivile, og Amnesty International krevde etterforskning. Regjeringen utsatte de første post-uavhengighetsvalgene igjen, nå planlagt til februar 2027, mens opposisjonsstyrker fortsetter kamper med regjeringshæren i Akobo. Guvernører i Jonglei og Aweil East oppfordret til fred før det utsatte valget, og et bakholdsangrep på en konvoi drepte to personer, inkludert en journalist. Et CityLink Aviation-fly styrtet ned ved Juba, og alle 14 ombord omkom. Det var 2 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Al-Shabaab continues probe attacks testing Kenya's border defenses while militia forces killed eight Somali civilians near the Kenya-Ethiopia border. Ugandan troops are withdrawing from Somalia, prompting security concerns around Mogadishu, and Uganda denies that its soldiers were killed in the country. Somalia joined 17 nations in condemning an Israeli strike on a Gaza hospital and a Somali refugee woman was killed by Houthi shelling of a camp in Lahj. Rainstorms in Lower Shabelle killed a mother and two children, and protests erupted in Hirshabelle over the regional election as al-Shabaab seized Coomaad. The conflict produced 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Somalia sluttet seg til 17 nasjoner i å fordømme et israelsk angrep på et sykehus i Gaza, og en somalisk flyktningkvinne ble drept av houthiene som skjøt missiler mot en leir i Lahj. Regnstormer i Lower Shabelle drepte en mor og to barn, og protester brøt ut i Hirshabelle over det regionale valget da al-Shabaab tok kontroll over Coomaad. Konflikten førte til 2 284 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Bandits have intensified attacks in Zamfara, killing worshippers in a mosque during Subhi prayer, abducting women and children, and clashing with vigilantes, resulting in dozens of deaths and the rescue of 19 hostages after 22 days. President Tinubu publicly sought forgiveness from victims of the Plateau attack and pledged reconstruction support, while also urging unity. The military reported the rescue of 119 abducted travellers and the killing of terrorists in a single week. AI-generated disinformation is now influencing the upcoming election, adding an information-war element to the conflict. The conflict recorded 1,486 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

President Tinubu ba offentlig om tilgivelse til ofrene for angrepet i Plateau og lovet støtte til gjenoppbygging, samtidig som han oppfordret til enhet. Militæret rapporterte at 119 bortførte reisende ble reddet og at terrorister ble drept i løpet av én uke. AI-generert desinformasjon påvirker nå det kommende valget og tilfører en informasjonskrig-dimensjon til konflikten. Konflikten har registrert 1 486 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.
